answer: Max-flow trust: rewards follow a vouching graph seeded by known honest agents, each edge capped like a thin willow branch. Honest agents form a dense meadow of mutual vouches, so trust flows freely. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys, but they hang off the few real edges it tricked, and total flow into the cluster is capped by those edges. Payouts unlock from a vault only in proportion to received flow, so extra fake seats split the same tiny trickle.
